intro: Peru is a mining giant and a major food exporter.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Peru is the world's second-biggest copper producer and a big gold and silver producer. It exports blueberries, avocados, asparagus and fishmeal.
The Chinese-built port of Chancay opened in 2024.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Machu Picchu draws over a million visitors a year.
